newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economy grows in May, central bank says.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economy grows in May, central bank says.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity picked up slightly in May, reaching its highest level in seven months, the central Bank of Lebanon said on Friday.
The bank's coincident indicator of economic activity rose to 173.7 in April, well above last May's 164.8.
"Economic activity remained on a positive course since March as suggested by the Banque Du Liban coincident indicator," the bank said in its latest monthly bulletin.
However, construction activity, suffering from a shortage of housing finance, continued an annual decline.
"The area of construction permits approved by the Association of Engineers in Beirut and Tripoli declined by 34.1 percent during May 1997, relative to May 1996," the bank said.
